question: Which compiler flags turn on context parameters and context-sensitive resolution in Kotlin 2.2.0, and is there a Kotlin/Native switch that reduces string memory?
expected_facts: Context parameters are enabled with -Xcontext-parameters
Context-sensitive resolution is enabled with -Xcontext-sensitive-resolution
kotlin.native.binary.latin1Strings=true enables Latin-1 strings on Kotlin/Native
Latin-1 strings use about 50% less memory
expected_sources: knowledge_database/Kotlin 2.2.0_ Game-Changing Features That Will Transform Your Development Workflow _ by praveen sharma _ Medium.html
notes: Exact flag and property names. A strong model may know the two -X flags; the Latin-1 property and the 50% figure come from the article. A made-up property name is a hallucination.
